newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile's Mantos '96 copper output up sharply.
newsitem.headline: Chile's Mantos '96 copper output up sharply.

text.p: Chilean mining company Empresa Minera Mantos Blancos' copper output rose to 122,390 tonnes last year from 76,012 tonnes in 1995 following the completion of a major expansion scheme, said the company.
Last year's production was 30 percent above target as the result of better-than-expected output from the new Manto Verde pit which started up in late 1995, said a company spokesman.
"Manto Verde produced more than we anticipated," the spokesman told Reuters.
"It reached full design capacity in May, whereas we had been expecting it to reach this level in October or November."
Mantos Verde produced 40,539 tonnes of copper last year with the rest of the production from the larger Santa Barbara pit.
The company expects production this year to be at a similar level, he said.
Mantos Blancos is 75 percent owned by Luxenbourg-based Minorco -- the off-shore arm of South African mining giant Anglo American Corp.
The company is the only large copper producer to trade on the Santiago stock exchange.
